DownloadTask

An object that can listen to download progress changes and cancel download tasks (Minimum version: 23.6.0)

Method

DownloadTask.abort()

Interrupting a Download Task

DownloadTask.onProgressUpdate(function listener)

Listening to the download progress change event

DownloadTask.offProgressUpdate(function listener)

The function for listening to the download progress change event is removed.

Sample Code

const downloadTask = ma.downloadFile({
    url: 'http://example.com/audio/123', //Just an example, not a real resource.
    success (res) {
        ma.playVoice({
            filePath: res.tempFilePath
        })
    }
})

downloadTask.onProgressUpdate((res) => {
    console.log('Download Progress', res.progress)
    console.log('Length of the downloaded data', res.totalBytesWritten)
    console.log('Expected total length of data to be downloaded', res.totalBytesExpectedToWrite)
})

downloadTask.abort() // Canceling a Download Task
